essay:
Your mind is clear. Your heart is racing. The world around you fades, and it's just you and the open road. That's a race in a nutshell: you commit at the start line, and you don't stop until you cross the finish.

Building software feels the same. A new challenge lands, and there's that same rush of anticipation, then the steady work of seeing it through, test by test, until it ships. And just like running, it rarely goes perfectly the first time. Every slow mile and every failed test teaches you something for the next one.

I'm lucky to feel that twice: on the road and in my work.
signature: Shane James Sweeney. You have to fail to succeed.
